meta.plant_name: Project Thunderbird Data Center power station

Capacity (MW).note: An OKC Fox news report (https://okcfox.com/news/local/project-thunderbird-data-center-proposal-promises-600-jobs-and-self-generated-power) says the developers plan up to 3.3 gigawatts of generation on site, powered by natural gas, for a 1,735 acre data center of four campuses.

units.notes: No ODEQ permit, commission cause or queue entry names this project yet. The turbine type is not stated in any document I found. Coverage from September 2026 shows the Enid rezoning is still being discussed, so the project is not quiet. The Enid city project page returned a 404.

qa.question: Does pre-construction fit Project Thunderbird before any air permit exists?
qa.finding: No air permit application, commission filing or queue entry was found. The only documents are news reports of a rezoning request that was delayed in September 2026 (https://okcfox.com/news/local/project-thunderbird-data-center-proposal-promises-600-jobs-and-self-generated-power).
qa.recommendation: Change status to announced unless a permit application or land purchase is found. Ask the reviewer to check the Garfield County and Enid records.
qa.note: The ODEQ permit harvest matched nothing. An air permit may have been requested under a different name.
